edition.authority: Second Vatican Council; Pope Paul VI
edition.notes: The official Latin Acta constituent contains numbered articles 1-25 on printed pp. 702-712, followed on p. 712 by the promulgation formula, date, papal signature, a reference to the common subscriptions printed on pp. 696-701, and the Decree's single Ambrose note. The separately printed shared subscriptions are not part of this constituent segment.
edition.title: Decretum de accommodata renovatione vitae religiosae Perfectae caritatis

passages.context: The Decree's complete numbered Latin body, beginning with article 1 on printed p. 702 and ending with article 25 on printed p. 712 immediately before the promulgation formula.
passages.notes: The beginning, numbered sequence, article-25 endpoint, and transition to promulgation were checked against the exact Acta artifact. The passage excludes the promulgation apparatus, common subscriptions referenced on pp. 696-701, and sole source note; no complete diplomatic transcription or word-for-word image collation is claimed.

work.author: Second Vatican Council
work.description: The Second Vatican Council's Decree on the Adaptation and Renewal of Religious Life, solemnly promulgated by Pope Paul VI on 28 October 1965. It comprises numbered articles 1-25; edition records distinguish the Latin Acta witness from dated Vatican web delivery states and translations.
